title: Jacob's Ladder Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Jacob’s Ladder Bible Crossword
description: Solve a Jacob's Ladder Bible crossword: the stone pillow, the angels ascending and descending, and Bethel. KJV clues from Genesis 28, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: Jacob leaves Beersheba with his brother's anger behind him, lights on a certain place at sunset, and takes a stone for a pillow. In the night he sees a ladder set up on the earth with its top reaching to heaven, and the angels of God going up and down on it. Jacob's Ladder makes a grid of Genesis 28.
The clues take in what he does when he wakes — the stone set up for a pillar, the oil poured on it, and the new name he gives the place. The closing verse is the dream itself.

clues.text: Set up on the earth, its top reaching to heaven
They ascended and descended on it
What Jacob took for his pillows
The name he gave the place, meaning house of God

verseText: And he dreamed, and behold a ladder set up on the earth, and the top of it reached to heaven: and behold the angels of God ascending and descending on it.
